blind.summary: The PR adds Hay Loop as a JSON-only third track (3 laps, width 11). It has a straight start, an S-bend bump, a teardrop hairpin at the east end with legs about 28 units apart, and one ramp at 0.63 on the back straight. Hay-bale rows sit inside the hairpin, tyre stacks outside it and at the west end, and 22 explicit cone trees fill the infield. There are no sim, render or UI changes. All gates pass: 623/623 unit tests, and the G2 bot lap on Hay Loop is 50.61 s, inside the 48–56 s target. The tests cover AC1–AC7 through public seams: the registry and nextTrackId, trackLayout, validateTrack, the runBotRace helper with one run per seed, and the race scene's prop cells. Each would fail on main because the track doesn't exist there. In the screenshots, the hairpin has a bale ring inside and tyre stacks outside. The minimap matches the S6 thumbnail shape, the six-car grid starts cleanly, and the results screen reads HAY LOOP. Nothing is broken or overlapping. Two minor problems: an extra review-tagged bale-overlap test that isn't in Expected files and picks the bales with a hard-coded coordinate filter, and a missing trailing newline in the JSON. There's no environment sniffing, and the PR doesn't repeat any merged or in-flight work.
